_readme: Monitored documentation sources for the sync-knowledge skill. Pinned allow-list only. 'change_signal' is 'learn-date' (compare Microsoft Learn updated_at/ms.date/git_commit_id) or 'content-hash' (no date available; hash the fetched content). On first real sync, populate hash/last_known_updated. Keep in agreement with references/links.md.

sources.notes: Authoritative plugin.json + marketplace.json schema, file locations, precedence. GitHub docs expose no date; use content-hash. Highest priority for the owned CLI scaffolder.
Plugin structure, install/test loop. Content-hash signal.

Skill discovery order (.github/skills > .agents/skills > .claude/skills > parents > ~/.copilot/skills > ~/.agents/skills > plugins > COPILOT_SKILLS_DIRS), /skills session commands, copilot skill CLI, install --skill --scope user|project. Content-hash signal.

Agent Plugins 1.0 in VS Code (GA 2026-08-12): auto-discovery of ~/.copilot/installed-plugins, chat.plugins.enabled / chat.plugins.marketplaces / chat.pluginLocations settings, workspace recommendations via .github/copilot/settings.json (extraKnownMarketplaces + enabledPlugins), Open Plugin Spec cross-tool story. Content-hash signal.
MCP vs REST plugin model; declarative-agent-only constraint. Learn updated_at signal.
Plugin manifest schema VERSION. v2.4 still current as of 2026-08-14 (no 2.5). Watch for a new version path replacing 2.4 — high-risk structural change, route through review.

Declarative agent manifest VERSION. v1.8 is current (2026-08-14): adds EmailActions + MeetingActions capabilities; EmbeddedKnowledge.files now required. Watch for 1.9 — update links and matrix on bump.
Cowork plugin/skill usage + management: self-service Upload plugin, automatic Claude-plugin package conversion, sharing/re-share to push updates, admin-deployed plugins. Learn updated_at signal.

Cowork Customize page (now Plugins + Skills tabs): guided skill creation and upload (.md/.zip/.skill, SKILL.md at archive root; 1 MB per .md, 10 MB compressed/50 MB uncompressed/100 files) and upload-plugin-package flow. Learn updated_at signal.

AUTHORITATIVE Cowork plugin package schema: M365 app package (.zip) with Unified App Manifest (current v1.29; v1.28 also accepted) and agentSkills[] + optional agentConnectors[], skills/<name>/SKILL.md (frontmatter name == folder), 192x192 + 32x32 icons, validation rules (ASKILL-*), and the Claude-plugin conversion script. Connector tool discovery: omit mcpToolDescription for dynamic tools/list (requires v1.29); set mcpToolDescription.file for static (works on v1.28). Watch for the next manifest version bump. WATCH (2026-08-14): the doc's sample now pins manifest v1.28 (strict, additionalProperties:false) and says mcpToolDescription is required — in tension with the v1.29 dynamic-discovery path this repo ships and has uploaded successfully (see lessons.md 2026-06-25). Unified manifest v1.30 (Aug 2026) is latest GA but only adds Outlook add-in fields. High-risk: verify against a real upload before changing templates.
MCP elicitation (elicitation/create) for structured mid-tool-call input in Cowork connectors: flat object, primitive fields only, no secrets. Form mode only.
